sloka: सवर्णकरणीं चापि तथा सञ्जीवनीमपि ।सन्धानकरणीं चापि गत्वा शीघ्रमिहानय ।। ६.१०२.२३ ।।
transliteration: savarṇakaraṇīṁ cāpi tathā sañjīvanīmapi ।sandhānakaraṇīṁ cāpi gatvā śīghramihānaya ।। 6.102.23 ।।

translations.english: "From the movement of his limbs and throbbing of his heart again and again it is known that he is alive."
